title: One Kid Finishes, Everyone Watches — Fixed | vitalii.no
description:
One TV, several kids, one shared house rule: finish your schoolwork, then watch. But the gate only ever checked whether one child was done — so the moment any sibling finished, the whole living room lit up, including the brothers who hadn't touched their own work yet.

A new strict_all_home flag in the settings table is read by a strictState() helper in workers/youtube-gate/index.js. The worker builds the day's list of children covered by the check, looks up each one's pass count in daily_subjects, and masks the stored tv_unlocked flag back to 0 unless every active child marked "home" has passed every subject. A live parent pass still overrides it for the youngest two kids, and a new toggle in AdminPage.tsx names exactly who is still missing work, child by child and subject by subject.

One finished child used to be enough to unlock the TV for the whole house. Now the screen stays dark until every single one of them has actually finished.
